faqPage.title: Simple answers about LoolyTv
faqPage.subtitle: New here? These are the questions parents ask when they first hear about the app.

what.a: LoolyTv is a kids video app for families. Parents pick playlists from a Made-for-Kids catalog our team reviews. Children then watch only those videos — not the open web.

purpose.a: It gives children a calm place to watch, without endless scrolling or surprise videos. You build a small family library; they press play and stay inside it.

how.a: Install LoolyTv on an Android phone, tablet, or TV and sign in with a parent Google account. Browse the catalog with your child and save playlists to your family library. Then tap Play all: the app shuffles what you chose, and kids stay on that list.

whoChooses.q: Who chooses the videos — me or my child?
whoChooses.a: You do. Kids play from the family library you saved. They cannot search the open web or wander onto videos you never picked.

vsYoutube.q: How is this different from YouTube or YouTube Kids?
vsYoutube.a: Those apps can still lead children toward videos you never chose. LoolyTv is a closed catalog: only Made-for-Kids playlists we review, plus the ones you save to your library.

devices.a: Android phone, tablet, and TV. You can link extra screens with a short code so the same family library follows you around the house.

ads.q: Are there ads in the app?
ads.a: No. LoolyTv does not show advertising inside the app.
